title: Light Brown Thai Fermented Dish Bowl
description: A fermented, glassy-jelly, meal-prep Thai dish featuring light brown soft sugar, perfect for paleo-friendly meals. This recipe is a variation of a traditional Thai dish.
instructions: Combine sugar, fish sauce, soy sauce, and rice vinegar in a saucepan and heat over low heat until sugar dissolves.
Bring to a boil and then remove from heat.
Let cool slightly before adding ginger, garlic, and cilantro.
Mix well and pour into a large glass jar.
Add salt and stir to combine.
Pack rice into separate glass jars or containers and top with the fermented sauce.
Seal the jars and let ferment in the refrigerator for at least 24 hours.
Once fermented, serve the rice with the fermented sauce and garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
